landing.headline: Your child's official golf record
landing.body: Follow your child's level and completed courses, and receive their certificates. Scan the QR code on the Golf Passport booklet to get started.
landing.installHint: Tip: add the app to your home screen for quicker access.

pages.activateBody: Enter the code printed in the booklet or on the paper certificate.
pages.legalDraft: This content is being drafted and will be reviewed by a lawyer before launch.
